title: US Treasury to double long-dated debt buybacks to battle surging yields
description: The US Treasury will double its buyback operations for long-dated government debt. This move aims to provide liquidity and ease rising bond yields for investors. The increased buybacks will apply to securities maturing between ten and thirty years. This action follows a sharp bond selloff which pushed yields higher. The Treasury seeks to manage market pressures and borrowing costs effectively.

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday

title: Estee Lauder bets on fragrances and skincare to deliver strong annual profit
description: Estee Lauder projects robust annual profits that are set to surpass Wall Street's expectations. The company's growth is heavily fueled by luxury fragrances, including popular lines such as Tom Ford and Le Labo. Estee Lauder anticipates an ongoing demand surge from young, affluent consumers while strategically broadening its brand presence in both China and international markets, aiming to enhance its makeup and hair care categories alongside its fragrances.

title: Goldman Sachs backs D-street debutante Shiprocket, buys over 40 lakh shares

title: BSE looks to launch MSCI-linked futures and options in India
description: BSE has partnered with MSCI to explore futures and options contracts linked to MSCI indexes in India, subject to regulatory approvals. The move could broaden BSE’s derivatives offerings, strengthen index-based investing and provide investors additional tools to hedge India exposure.

title: Moderna shares soar 159% in a day after cancer vaccine succeeds in late-stage trial
description: Moderna shares surged after its personalized mRNA cancer vaccine trial showed positive results. The treatment, combined with Keytruda, reduced melanoma recurrence and spread significantly. This marks the first successful late-stage trial for an mRNA cancer vaccine. The findings offer hope for future growth beyond COVID-19 vaccines. Discussions with regulators are expected within the next few months.

title: Marvell shares jump 8% after chipmaker hands Google option to buy $12.2 billion stake

title: Target Corp shares rise 5% as sales rebound and profit doubles in Q2
